reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for durable orchestration of external coding-agent CLIs, including queued execution, testing, review, persistence, recovery, artifacts, and an authenticated web dashboard.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中编排多个外部编码代理 CLI，提供持久化任务队列、测试审查、日志产物、恢复重试和 Web 仪表盘。
summaries.en: Orchestrates multiple external coding-agent CLIs in DeepSeek Harness with persistent queues, testing, review, logs, artifacts, recovery, retries, and a web dashboard.

capabilities: Creates, queues, retries, cancels, and resumes persistent coding jobs
Runs tests and independent reviews and records logs, diffs, and artifacts
Reads and writes workspace files and may create isolated Git worktrees
Exposes authenticated Web dashboard, REST endpoints, and SSE events
May inherit host environment variables, including credentials, for child processes
